comment: The one list of ports no test in this repo may ever bind (round 1 finding 20).
Before this file there were four lists in four files and they disagreed: the
studio route suite avoided 7431/7614/7615 but not 7560, the browser harness
picked freely from 20000-60000 with no exclusions at all, and nothing avoided
7632, which is where a live agent seat's studio was actually running while the
review was written. A test that lands on one of these takes down something
Data, not Python, because node (studio/tests/run.mjs) reads it too. The three
readers are studio/tests/py/ports.py, grade/tests/ports.py and run.mjs itself;
add a port HERE and all three pick it up.

why.7431: the founder's live studio (studio/server.py's own default port)
why.7560: sam/server.py's own default port: the SAM service a real studio expects
why.7614: reserved by this workspace for a studio a person is using
why.7615: reserved by this workspace for a studio a person is using
why.7632: a Codex agent seat's studio, running out of this same worktree
why.8756: the always-on launchd Granite ASR 5 server on this machine
why.22929: a real server found squatting this port while the spike ran
why.28958: a real server found squatting this port while the spike ran
